event_chain.summary: Misdelivery of adoption details by email

summary: In December 2025 Devon County Council's adoption services mistakenly emailed confidential adoption information about two children (aged 10 and 2) and their adoptive parents' details to an unrelated woman in Cornwall, who reported the GDPR breach to the press.
